input.summary: Extend licence grant to AP affiliates and contractors, allow successor transfer, and remove at-will revocability
input.comment: [Playbook] We extended the Auction Platform licence to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, confirmed it transfers to a successor in an M&A transaction, and tied revocation to termination of the Agreement rather than Kubient's discretion. Our playbook does not permit a licence that is revocable at will or that excludes affiliates and contractors with no path to add them.

ops.oldText: Kubient hereby grants to Customer a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license to access
ops.newText: Kubient hereby grants to Customer, its affiliates and its contractors acting on Customer's behalf a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive license, transferable to any successor by way of merger, stock sale, consolidation or similar transaction or to a purchaser of all or substantially all of Customer's assets related to the subject matter of this Agreement, and revocable only upon expiration or termination of this Agreement in accordance with paragraph 4, to access
